GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Buch
   C. Wasser
   D. Haus

2. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

3. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.

4. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

5. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

6. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.

7. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.

8. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.

9. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

10. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

11. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

12. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading Skimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive reading Scanning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension Extensive reading ● World currencies, ● Banking services ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
